首次使用请创建唯一管理员账户，密码至少 8 位。: Create your administrator account. Use a password of at least 8 characters.
登录以管理代理站点和 Caddy 配置。: Sign in to manage your sites and Caddy configuration.
申请记录独立管理；相同域名的站点选择“自动 HTTPS”即可使用。: Requests are managed separately. Sites using the same domain can select Automatic HTTPS.
申请期间实时显示 Caddy 的验证与签发进度；签发后自动读取有效期并显示续期状: Validation and issuance progress updates live. Expiry and renewal status appear after issuance. Caddy retries DNS or validation failures in the background.
通过 DNS API 添加验证记录，不需要开放验证端口；凭据需要对应区域的写入权: Creates DNS validation records via API. No inbound validation port is needed. Credentials need write access to the zone.
域名须解析至此服务器，公网 80 端口须可达；不支持泛域名。: The domain must resolve to this server and public port 80 must be reachable. Wildcards are not supported.
使用本机 CA 签发。客户端需自行信任 Caddy 根证书，不能作为公网受信任证: Issued by the local CA. Clients must trust the Caddy root certificate. This is not a publicly trusted certificate.
提交后由 Caddy 在后台申请并自动续期；同域名站点选择“自动 HTTPS”即: Caddy requests and renews certificates in the background. Select Automatic HTTPS on matching sites. Update any conflicting TLS configuration first.
尚未申请证书，可从右上角申请证书。: No requests yet. Request a certificate using the button above.
禁止境外 IP（仅允许中国大陆及内网）: Block foreign IPs (allow mainland China & private networks)
时间须在未来一年内。编辑后立即应用；到期后自动撤销。手动规则不会被自动防护覆盖。: Expiry must be within one year. Changes apply immediately and expire automatically. Automatic protection does not overwrite manual rules.
同时覆盖 IPv4 / IPv6，保留内网及回环访问。依据 APNIC 的 CN: Covers IPv4 and IPv6 while allowing private and loopback access. APNIC CN allocations approximate mainland China, excluding Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan. Uses the direct peer IP; behind a CDN or proxy, the proxy address is evaluated. This rule does not replace authentication.
手动封禁 IP 或 CIDR 网段，长期有效，需手动解除。自动防护仍会封禁重复触: Manually block an IP or CIDR subnet. Bans stay in place until you lift them. Automatic protection still blocks repeated 400/401/403 sources.
默认为永久封禁，需手动解除。保存后立即应用；手动规则不会被自动防护覆盖。: Bans are permanent until lifted manually. Changes apply as soon as you save, and automatic protection never overrides manual rules.
以下偏好即时生效，保存在当前浏览器。: Preferences apply immediately and are saved in this browser.
全部站点的上行与下行合计，按整点汇总: Upload plus download across all sites, aggregated hourly
近 24 小时暂无流量，站点收到请求后会在这里出现曲线。: No traffic in the last 24 hours. The curve appears once your sites receive requests.
减少站点和任务列表的留白: Reduce spacing in site and task lists
关闭后保留请求数与流量统计: Request and traffic totals remain visible
未指定页面地址时使用: Used when no page is specified
仅重置外观、刷新和显示偏好。: Resets appearance, refresh and display preferences only.
控制页面轮询；DDNS 定时任务由服务器独立运行。: Controls browser polling. Scheduled DDNS jobs run independently on the server.
流量、DDNS 状态及证书进度: Traffic, DDNS status and certificate progress
DDNS 与申请中证书每秒更新: DDNS and pending certificates update every second
回到页面后立即获取最新数据: Refresh immediately when returning to the page
鼠标停留在站点日志图标时预览: Preview when hovering over the site log icon
管理入口与 Web 反代监听分别配置。: The panel endpoint and Web listeners are configured separately.
修改后面板服务重启。通过域名反代访问时，需要同步修改对应站点的上游端口。: The panel restarts after a port change. If accessed through a reverse proxy, update its upstream port as well.
我已了解访问地址及反代上游需要同步调整: I understand that the access URL and proxy upstream may need updating
支持字母、数字、点、横线和下划线，3–64 位。修改后当前会话保留，其他会话退出: Use 3–64 letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores. Other sessions are signed out; this session remains active.
至少 8 位。修改成功后其他会话退出，当前会话保留。: At least 8 characters. Other sessions are signed out; this session remains active.
读取当前会话数量后可管理其他登录。: Other sessions can be managed after the session count loads.
偏好即时保存 · 端口和密码需单独提交: Preferences save instantly · Submit port and password changes separately
真实 HTTP / TCP 探测，持续记录连接状态与响应延迟: Real HTTP / TCP probes track availability and response latency
选择 Web 上游或自定义 HTTP / TCP 目标，后台会定时检测。: Choose a Web upstream or a custom HTTP / TCP target. The server checks it on schedule.
HTTP 检查验证 TLS 证书；TCP 检查仅代表端口可连接。探测在 Viya: HTTP checks validate TLS certificates; TCP checks only confirm connectivity. Probes run on the Viya server; the last 40 results are retained.
空站点列表，不继承任何监听配置: Start with an empty site list; no inherited configuration
复制站点及全部规则，后续独立编辑: Copy sites and all rules; edit independently afterwards
端口检测针对服务器本地绑定，不代表公网防火墙已放行。HTTP-01 验证仍要求公: Checks local binding only, not public firewall access. HTTP-01 still requires public port 80.
点击添加站点，将流量转发到你的服务。: Add a site to route traffic to your service.
只需填写前缀，例如 qb；最终访问域名为: Enter only a prefix, such as qb. The final domain is
填写完整域名，不包含 http:// 或路径。: Enter a full domain without http:// or a path.
填写 http(s):// 地址。端口可省略，HTTP 默认 80，HTTPS: Enter an http(s):// URL. Ports are optional: HTTP defaults to 80; HTTPS to 443.
默认使用海蓝色图标。: Ocean blue is the default icon color.
留空匹配整个域名，例如 /api: Leave empty for all paths, or enter /api
留空时整个域名都转发；填写路径后仅匹配该路径和它下面的子路径。: Leave empty to proxy the entire domain. Otherwise only this path and its subpaths are matched.
Caddy 自动申请和续期证书。公网域名需解析到此服务器，并确保 HTTP/HT: Caddy requests and renews certificates automatically. Public domains must resolve to this server with validation ports reachable.
DNS-01 可签发泛域名证书。先选择已保存的 DNS 凭据，首次使用可在这里添: DNS-01 supports wildcard certificates. Choose saved DNS credentials or add them here.
此站点只通过 HTTP 提供服务，不会申请 TLS 证书。: This site uses HTTP only and does not request a TLS certificate.
使用已上传且 SAN 覆盖此域名的证书。: Use an uploaded certificate whose SAN covers this domain.
使用 Caddy 本地 CA。客户端需手动信任该 CA 根证书。: Use the local Caddy CA. Clients must explicitly trust its root certificate.
HTTP-01 需要公网域名和可从互联网访问的 80 端口；不支持泛域名。: HTTP-01 requires a public domain and reachable port 80. Wildcards are not supported.
选择覆盖此域名的证书: Select a certificate covering this domain
隐藏请求头、IP 过滤和限速: Hide headers, IP filtering and rate limits
请求头、IP 白名单/黑名单、限速: Headers, IP allow/deny lists, rate limits
每行一条，格式为“名称: 值”。: One per line, in Name: Value format.
替换密码（留空保留原密码）: New password (leave empty to keep current)
IP 白名单（每行一个 IP 或 CIDR）: IP allowlist (one IP or CIDR per line)
IP 黑名单（每行一个 IP 或 CIDR）: IP denylist (one IP or CIDR per line)
为站点起一个便于识别的名称: Choose a name to identify this site
仅用于面板中识别，不影响访问域名。: Used in the panel only; it does not affect the hostname.

未匹配泛域名证书的 HTTPS 站点由 Caddy 单独申请并续期，自动同步到此: Caddy requests and renews individual certificates for HTTPS sites without a matching wildcard. They appear here automatically.
暂无独立申请的站点证书；匹配到的泛域名证书可在 Web 站点查看复用标记。: No individual site certificates. Wildcard reuse is marked in the Web site list.
等待引擎签发，查看申请进度或引擎日志: Awaiting engine issuance; check request progress or engine logs
只接受未加密 PEM 私钥；服务端会校验证书和私钥匹配、SAN 与有效期。上传后: Only unencrypted PEM private keys are accepted. The server validates key matching, SAN and validity. Select a matching certificate on the site after upload.
PEM 证书和匹配的私钥保存在受限权限目录，可绑定到代理站点。: PEM certificates and matching private keys are stored in a restricted directory and can be bound to sites.
密钥以 AES-256-GCM 加密后保存在本机数据库。: Keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM in the local database.
使用仅具备所需 DNS 区域写入权限的 API 凭据。密钥不会再次回显。替换凭据: Use API credentials with write access only to required zones. Secrets are not shown again. Enter all required fields when replacing credentials.
填写目标主机名，不是 IP 地址。任务会按间隔将别名指向此域名。: Enter a hostname, not an IP. The task periodically points the alias to this domain.
选择这条 DNS 记录使用的 IP: Select the IP for this DNS record
有多个 IPv6 时请选公网全局地址，并优先选择长期稳定、不会定期变化的地址。系: With multiple IPv6 addresses, prefer a stable global address. This exact address is used. If it disappears from the interface, the task reports an error instead of switching silently.
此接口暂时没有对应 IP 版本的地址。可换一个接口或改用公网接口查询。: This interface has no address of the required version. Choose another interface or public lookup.
通过多个公网 IP 查询接口轮询获取地址，适用于路由器 NAT 或网卡上没有公网: Queries multiple public IP services. Useful behind router NAT or when interfaces have no public address.
CNAME 任务会定时把记录指向上方目标域名；CNAME 记录不能与同名的 A/: Periodically points the CNAME at the target above. CNAME cannot coexist with A, AAAA or other records of the same name.
网卡方式会在每次更新时精确使用选择的 IP 地址；建议选网卡上用于公网解析的长期: Interface mode uses the exact selected address. Prefer a stable public address. For private interface addresses, public lookup is recommended.
由 Caddy Layer4 直接监听主机端口，请确认防火墙已放行。: Caddy Layer4 binds directly to the host port. Ensure the firewall permits access.
服务规则、监听、DNS 凭据、证书、账户、监控与浏览器偏好，统一加密备份。: Encrypted backups include service rules, listeners, DNS credentials, certificates, accounts, monitors and browser preferences.
文件包含账户配置、API 凭据与证书私钥；下载文件使用备份密码加密，导入时需要相: Includes accounts, API credentials and certificate private keys. The download is encrypted with your backup password; the same password is required to import. Sessions and access logs are not restored.

流量概览统计全部站点；搜索和状态筛选仅影响站点列表。: Traffic totals include all sites. Search and status filters affect only the site list.
暂无该站点的访问记录。收到请求后约 2 秒更新。: No requests for this site yet. Updates about 2 seconds after a request.
确认后立即执行，请核对要操作的项目。: This takes effect immediately. Check the selected item before confirming.
输入域名、名称或地址，支持多个关键词: Search domains, names or addresses with multiple keywords
未找到匹配项目，可清除筛选后重试。: No matches. Clear the filters and try again.
Caddy 尚未就绪，请检查配置历史和服务状态: Caddy is not ready. Check configuration history and service status.
自动刷新可在左下角设置中暂停；手动刷新始终可用。: Pause automatic refresh in Settings at the lower left. Manual refresh is always available.
点击功能卡片进入管理；配置失败时可从最近配置状态查看原因。: Open a feature card to manage it. Review the latest configuration status if an application fails.
选择监听入口，管理独立站点与证书来源。: Select a listener to manage its sites and certificate sources.
先选择 HTTP / HTTPS 监听，再添加域名和上游地址；各监听独立管理站点: Choose an HTTP / HTTPS listener, then add a domain and upstream URL. Listeners manage independent sites. New listeners start empty or can explicitly import an existing configuration.
先选择 DNS 凭据和 Zone，再选择记录类型与地址来源。: Choose DNS credentials and a zone, then the record type and address source.
每个任务独立按设定间隔探测公网 IPv4 或 IPv6 并更新记录。: Each task checks its public IPv4 or IPv6 address and updates DNS on its own schedule.
自动更新复选框控制服务器定时任务；关闭后仍可手动更新。: The automatic-update checkbox controls server scheduling. Manual updates remain available when disabled.
多个 IPv6 时优先选稳定公网地址；临时地址可能定期变化。: Prefer stable public IPv6 addresses. Temporary addresses may rotate.
先添加 DNS 凭据，再申请证书或创建 Web 服务。: Add DNS credentials before requesting certificates or creating Web services.
保存服务商的 API 凭据，供证书申请和 DDNS 共用。: Save provider API credentials for certificate requests and DDNS.
列表不显示密钥；替换凭据会影响引用该凭据的任务。: Secrets are hidden. Replacing credentials affects all jobs using them.
公网证书推荐 DNS-01；可申请 *.example.com 泛域名证书。: DNS-01 is recommended for public certificates and supports *.example.com wildcards.
已有 PEM 证书使用下方上传入口；站点需选择匹配的 TLS 配置。: Upload existing PEM certificates below and select matching TLS settings on your sites.
可按站点永久封禁单个 IP 或 CIDR 网段，随时手动解除。: Permanently ban an IP or CIDR subnet per site, and lift it whenever you want.
手动与自动封禁分别标记；解除封禁需要确认。: Manual and automatic bans are labeled separately. Removing a ban requires confirmation.
实时 JSON 请求记录；凭据头和查询参数已隐藏。自动封禁仅计入重复的 400、: Live JSON request logs hide credential headers and query parameters. Automatic bans count repeated 400, 401 and 403 responses.
记录配置提交和 Caddy 应用结果；失败记录用于定位错误。: Records configuration submissions and Caddy application results. Failed entries help diagnose issues.
配置保存与生效是两个步骤；应用失败时请查看原因并重新应用。: Saving and applying are separate steps. Review failures and reapply after fixing them.
填写 Debian 主机监听地址、端口和上游 host:port；选择 TCP、: Enter the Debian listen address, port and upstream host:port. Choose TCP, UDP or both.
填写域名与上游地址，再选择证书方式。访问路径选填；IP 规则和限速位于高级设置。: Enter a domain and upstream, then choose TLS settings. Paths are optional; IP rules and rate limits are under Advanced.
已有主域名可直接添加子域名；访问路径留空表示匹配整个域名。: Add subdomains under an existing domain. Leave the path empty to match the entire domain.
日志图标支持悬浮预览；克隆可复用配置；删除前会再次确认。: Hover over the log icon to preview. Clone to reuse settings. Deletion requires confirmation.
监听独立管理站点，主域名分组下可继续添加子域名。: Listeners manage independent sites. Add subdomains inside domain groups.
HTTP-01 需要公网 80 端口可达；内部 CA 证书需客户端自行信任。: HTTP-01 requires reachable public port 80. Clients must trust internal CA certificates explicitly.
监听端口需可用并放行防火墙，不能占用面板或 Web 服务端口。: The listen port must be free and allowed by the firewall; avoid panel or Web listener ports.
查看引擎状态和各项服务的配置情况。: View engine health and service configuration.
查看 Caddy 配置应用结果与错误详情。: View Caddy configuration results and error details.
管理用于证书验证与动态域名的 DNS 服务商凭据。: Manage DNS provider credentials for certificate validation and dynamic DNS.
申请证书、查看签发状态和管理自定义证书。: Request certificates, track issuance and manage custom certificates.
新增、编辑或解除站点 IP / 网段封禁规则。: Add, edit or remove per-site IP and subnet bans.
查看代理请求的实时访问记录。: View live access logs for proxy requests.
查看代理请求的时间、域名、路径和响应状态；查询参数与凭据已隐藏。: View request time, domain, path and status. Query parameters and credentials are hidden.
定时检查公网地址并更新 DNS 记录。: Check public addresses and update DNS records on schedule.
管理独立监听的 TCP / UDP 转发规则。: Manage independent TCP / UDP forwarding listeners.
监听端口会直接绑定 Debian 主机。低于 1024 的端口需相应系统权限；请: Ports bind directly on Debian. Ports below 1024 require appropriate privileges. Avoid management and HTTP/HTTPS ports.
